Real-time sharing allows you to modify a strategy board together with party members.

While all players will be able to view the strategy board, only the player who initiated real-time sharing can make direct edits.
Moreover, the Undo and Redo functions, as well as the selection of multiple objects, are not available when real-time sharing.

Please note that real-time sharing will be suspended during combat or when players leave or join your party. However, any changes made to the strategy board will be saved automatically to the Shared List, where you can resume editing at a later time.

Because real-time edits are overwritten periodically, you may wish to create a copy to preserve the original strategy board.
Sharing Strategy Boards
Party Sharing

Single strategy boards or entire folders can be shared with party members via the Share with Party subcommand.

Any strategy boards shared in this manner will be saved temporarily in the Shared List.
The mission selection list provides detailed information on the stellar missions available to you.

■Mission Types
Missions are divided into three categories based on conditions of availability. Select an icon to display the respective missions.

・Basic Missions
　Generally available missions.

・Provisional Missions
　Missions with restricted availability, such as during certain times
　or weather phenomena.
　The icon will show an exclamation mark when missions are available.

・Critical Missions
　Missions only available during red alerts.
Traveling to Mission Sites
Critical missions require you to craft or procure materials at a designated location. Speak with Lefleda while a red alert is active to travel directly to the mission site.
※Stellar missions will be automatically abandoned upon leaving the relevant exploration zone.
The Final Verse
Entry
The Final Verse is a practice duty that pits a party of up to four players against a simulacrum of Eminent Grief. Players may speak with Vanthau to challenge this duty with a fixed or matched party.
Difficulty Level

The boss summoned by invoking the Final Verse is a perfect replica of the fiend lurking beyond traverse stone 99. By practicing against this simulacrum, players will become better equipped to overcome Eminent Grief within Pilgrim's Traverse.
Rewards
Upon victory, a treasure coffer will appear. All party members may receive rewards upon opening this treasure coffer.
The Blessed Hoard
About the Blessed Hoard

Players may obtain pieces of the Blessed Hoard by completing challenge log objectives for Pilgrim's Traverse, or by clearing the two duties unlocked over the course of the dungeon.

Just as with the Accursed Hoard, pieces of the Blessed Hoard must be appraised by Tyr Marn in Wolekdorf to ascertain their true value.
A Different Deep Dungeon
Construction

Pilgrim's Traverse differs from previous deep dungeons in a variety of ways. The changes you can expect to find are outlined below, using the Palace of the Dead as a contrasting example. ■Floors The Palace of the Dead has a total of two hundred floors, whereas Pilgrim's Traverse has one hundred areas available for exploration. ■Entry Points You may re-enter the dungeon from waypoints should your party KO or if you reset your progress. These entry points become available after clearing certain areas and completing quests unlocked by dungeon progression. In the Palace of the Dead, players can only re-enter from floors 1 or 51. Pilgrim's Traverse offers entry points from stones 1, 21, 31, 51, and 71. ■Matched Parties All floors after floor 100 of the Palace of the Dead are designed strictly as a challenge for players and only accessible to fixed parties. However, Pilgrim's Traverse allows players to challenge comparable areas, beginning with stone 31, with matched parties. Please note that from stone 91 onwards, the matching system cannot be used to add members. ■Independent Duties Two independent duties can be unlocked by proceeding through Pilgrim's Traverse. Tabs with more information on each will be added to this menu when they are unlocked.
Special Items and Features

Some items and features found within this dungeon are unique to Pilgrim's Traverse. ■Special Items Alongside pomanders, treasure coffers in Pilgrim's Traverse may contain juniper incense, which can be burned to call the faerie king. Check the Special Items tab for more information. ■Special Features In Pilgrim's Traverse, you may encounter votive candelabras, which may be lit to trigger effects in the subsequent area. Check the Votive Candelabras tab for more information.
Rewards

Alongside pieces of the Accursed Hoard, Pilgrim's Traverse offers a variety of rewards. ■Challenge Log Rewards Entries for Pilgrim's Traverse have been added to the deep dungeon category of the challenge log. Completing them will earn players special rewards. The challenge log may be checked via the main menu or by speaking with Vanthau. ■The Blessed Hoard Players can collect pieces of the Blessed Hoard by completing challenge log objectives or clearing related duties. Check the Blessed Hoard tab for more information.
Sprig Cleaning
Overview
Special Actions
Scores
Unusual Leafkin
By participating in Sprig Cleaning, you will use special actions to help clear away pests that are impeding Hatching-tide festivities.

■Basic Rules
Sprig Cleaning is a solo duty with a three-minute time limit.

Use special actions to trim back the menacing weeds you encounter and aim for the highest score possible.

■Rewards
Players will receive special brilliant eggs proportionate to their score. These rewards can be exchanged for gear and items by speaking with the Dreamer in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
Three unique actions are available to you during Sprig Cleaning.

■Pruning Pirouette
A circular area of effect attack.

■Roaring Eggscapade
An attack that moves you swiftly forward, slicing down foes in your path.

■The Spriganator
A large circular area of effect attack that can only be executed upon attaining sufficient cleaning spirit, displayed in an instance-specific gauge.

You may increase your score in the following ways:

■Trimming Troublesome Traps
You will earn points for each pesky leafkin that you cut down to size.

■Reclaiming Archon Eggs
Hidden amongst the troublesome traps are Archon eggs meant for egg hunt participants. Collecting gold, silver, and bronze Archon eggs will earn you a different number of points for each type.

Your current score and high score will be displayed in the duty list.
You may encounter transcendental traps during Sprig Cleaning.

Trimming these leafkin will randomly apply one of the following benefits:

・A significant increase to your cleaning gauge

・Status Effect: Enhanced Egg Acuity
　Improves your chances of discovering Archon eggs.

・Status Effect: Golden Eye
　Ensures all Archon eggs discovered are gold.

■Crafting and Gathering Restrictions
During a stellar mission, crafting and gathering will not award experience, and spiritbond will accrue at a different rate.

■Fishing Restrictions
At the end of each stellar mission, your Angler's Art stacks will be reset, regardless of how many you have accrued.

■Ground Support Bonuses
Ground supporters who make sufficient contributions to a mech op will receive bonus credits for a set number of subsequent missions, regardless of objective. These bonuses are as follows:

Cosmocredits: +20
Sector Credits: +10

For the duration of the effect, an arrow symbol will be displayed on the Initiate button on the mission selection window.
Gold Count

Your gold count refers to a special bonus that accrues as high-level missions are completed in succession. ■Activation Conditions To start a gold count, consecutively attain gold stars in class A basic missions, including those designated as EX or EX+, or provisional missions. Changing classes will not break this streak. Upon attaining another gold star after accruing 5 golds, you will achieve Super Star status and your gold count will reset to zero. Each cosmic exploration field has a separate gold count which will be retained even if you leave the area. ■Bonus Effect An active gold count will yield increased rewards for stellar missions, with Super Star status offering the highest bonus. Gold count and Super Star bonuses affect all credit types, dronebits, and contributions to the Starward Standings. You can confirm your current gold count via the mission selection list.

■Reset Conditions
The following actions will break a gold count streak:
・Initiating a class B, C, or D mission.
・Completing a mission with a rating below Gold Star.
・Abandoning a mission (unless the mission was automatically abandoned due to your mech ops pilot application having been selected).

Conversely, the following actions will not break a gold count streak:
・Taking part in mech ops.
・Taking part in cosmic exploration projects.
・Initiating and/or completing other types of missions, such as critical missions.
Artifact Search
Overview

Where there are ruins, there are treasures just begging to be found! To begin the artifact search, you'll need to launch a reconnaissance drone by using a drone module, the type of which differs between stars. ■How to Obtain Drone Modules Within cosmic exploration zones that contain ruins, whenever your gold count is activated through the consecutive completion of class A basic missions and/or provisional missions, you will receive dronebits alongside the other rewards. (Please refer to the Gold Count section of the exotablet for more information.) Dronebits may be traded to Kaede at the local rainbow crystal in exchange for drone modules.
How to Use Drone Modules
Using a drone module will launch a reconnaissance drone and initiate its artifact scanning subroutines. The locations of discovered artifacts will be marked on your map for your convenience.
Once you arrive at the marked location, interact with the artifact to conduct analysis.

Successful analysis will produce an ancient record, completing the artifact search. The ancient record may then be submitted to Kaede at the local rainbow crystal in exchange for a variety of rewards.

The icon representing saved outfits will also indicate the number of individual items presently being used as part of the outfit glamour. An orange number indicates all parts have been stored together.

As with standard glamours, outfit glamours will appear in each tab of the glamour dresser. Their item descriptions will also indicate they are part of an outfit glamour.
Adding Outfit Gear

It is possible to add gear to incomplete outfit glamours stored in the glamour dresser, requiring the equivalent number of glamour prisms to do so.

With the missing gear in your inventory or Armoury Chest, open the Outfits tab of the glamour dresser, choose an outfit glamour you wish to add gear to, then select “Add Missing Outfit Gear” from the subcommand menu.

Gear can also be added via the Outfit Glamour button in the Glamour Creation window.
If an outfit glamour matching the selected gear is available in the glamour dresser, pressing this button will automatically select that outfit for gear additions.
Worqor Chirteh (Triumph)
Map Overview

Far to the west of Eorzea, across the Indigo Deep, lies the continent of Tural. Here, in the mountainous region of Worqor Chirteh, a great battle is said to have been waged by the Yok Huy of ancient times. The Grand Companies would borrow this battlefield of eld to test their mettle, and, under the watchful gaze of the snow spirits, the sounds of conflicts past and present echo through the mountainside once more.
Victory Conditions

In Worqor Chirteh (Triumph), victory goes to the first alliance to reach the specified tactical rating, which is accumulated by:
　1. Defeating enemy players
　2. Claiming triumphs

In the event that none of the three alliances reaches the specified tactical rating within the time limit, victory will be awarded to the alliance with the highest tactical rating.
Triumphs

Across the field of battle, there are points of tactical importance known as triumphs. By laying claim to these locations, players can increase their team's tactical rating over time. ■Triumph States■ In the course of battle, triumphs will assume one of four states, in the following order: 1. Inactive When inactive, a triumph cannot be claimed. All triumphs are inactive at the onset of battle, but as time passes, they will randomly begin activating.

2. Activating
When a triumph begins activating, a symbol will appear above it indicating the time remaining before it becomes unclaimed. The symbol will gradually take shape until it becomes complete, rendering the triumph unclaimed.

3. Unclaimed
When a triumph is unclaimed, several fields of triumph will appear around it. Once a single team secures all fields, they will claim the triumph for themselves.

4. Claimed
When claimed, a triumph gradually increases a team's tactical rating. A triumph that has been claimed cannot be seized by the opposition; however, after a certain amount of time has elapsed, it will revert to being inactive. When it does so, a triumph in a different location will become unclaimed.

■Triumph Rank■ When a triumph begins activating, it will randomly be assigned a rank: B, A, or S, as indicated by the corresponding shape. While higher-ranked triumphs are rarer, they increase a team's tactical rating at a faster rate.

■Changes during Battle■ As the battle progresses, the number of triumphs that can be simultaneously active will decrease. At the same time, the likelihood that they will activate at a higher rank will increase. ■Changes Due to Weather■ Certain weather conditions increase the likelihood that triumphs will activate at a higher rank.
Fields of Triumph

Several fields of triumph will appear around an unclaimed triumph. Players can secure a field of triumph by remaining within the area for a set period of time. The number of players within the field does not affect the time required.

The higher the rank of the triumph, the more fields will appear.

Once a field of triumph has been secured, the opposition may attempt to seize it for themselves. Even though another team may have secured the field, the battle is far from over!
Snow
As time passes in a match, snow may begin to fall on Worqor Chirteh. While snow is falling, snow spirits will appear around the arena to engage in a bout of mischief-making.

■Snow Soldiers When snow spirits appear, they will cast Soldiers of 'Fridgeration to create snow troops of various sizes around the arena. These snow soldiers form obstacles that can be used to turn the tide of battle in your favor.
■Blessed Blast■ When snow spirits are present, they will repeatedly cast Blessed Blast. Players caught in this blast will be protected by a barrier that nullifies damage.
Auroras

As time passes in a match, auroras may appear in the skies over Worqor Chirteh. This weather condition causes the following two effects:
1. Increases the likelihood that triumphs will activate as a higher rank.
2. Gradually fills the limit gauge of all players.
Obtaining Aetherpool Weapons

You may use your illumed aetherpool weapon outside of Pilgrim's Traverse after clearing the area marked by stone 30 and completing the subsequent quest.

However, you must first forge a sufficient number of illumed aetherpool grips by speaking with Ose Wyd in Wolekdorf. Forging one grip will reduce the strength of your illumed aetherpool arm and armor by 10.

Once you have acquired enough illumed aetherpool grips, you may obtain a weapon of the First Light by speaking with Ose Wyd and selecting “Request to keep your aetherpool gear.”

Once you clear the area marked by stone 100 and enhance your illumed aetherpool arm to +60 or above, sacramental weapons will also become available.
Archeia Harmonias
An arena that assumes the form of a vast war library. On this battlefield, how each side overcomes the obstacle of the aetherometer will draw the line between victory and defeat.

■Aetherometer■ Aetherometers can be found halfway between the centerpoint and each team's checkpoint. Upon reaching an aetherometer, the tactical crystal's progress will be halted temporarily. During this time, the advancing team must remain in the crystal's ring to charge the aetherometer. When the aether index reaches 100%, an aetherial bridge will manifest, and the crystal can once again be moved. The aether index will revert to 0 if any of the following occurs during charging: - All members of the advancing team leave the crystal's ring. - A member of the opposing team enters the crystal's ring. Once an aetherometer is fully charged, its aether index will no longer revert to 0.
■Aetherial Bridge■ When an aetherometer is fully charged, an aetherial bridge will manifest and remain in place for the remainder of the match.

■Healing Glyph■ Each team has a healing glyph situated to the front of its starting point. While standing on the glyph, players will recover HP over time. Please note that this benefit is not granted by the opposing team's glyph.

■Jump Glyph■ Each team has a jump glyph situated at its base, which can be activated by fully charging their aetherometer. By stepping on the glyph, players can travel swiftly to the opposite platform.
Custom Deliveries
Satisfaction Level
Deliveries
Increasing the Value of Collectables
Overview

Custom deliveries are opportunities for Disciples of the Hand and Land to procure items for a client in need. By completing these deliveries, players will receive experience points and scrips, and deepen their relationship with the client in question. Clients may be unlocked by completing the main scenario and other sidequests. ■Basic Information You may view the satisfaction level, delivery list, and delivery allowances for every unlocked client by selecting Custom Deliveries on the Timers interface located under Duty in the main menu. Delivering desired items to your clients will increase their satisfaction level.
Overview

With each successful delivery, your client will come to trust you more and more, leading them to task you with assignments of greater importance. Your progress will be displayed in the form of a gauge atop the delivery list. Fill this gauge to the maximum, and your client's satisfaction level─as represented by little golden hearts─will increase.
Upon reaching a new satisfaction level, you will have the opportunity to learn more about your client and their story.
Custom Delivery Makeovers

Upon attaining the highest satisfaction level possible, certain clients will allow you to glamour their clothing according to your tastes. The presence of a gear icon beside the hearts indicates one such client.

■How to Perform a Makeover Speak with your client and select “Cast glamour” to change their attire. You may cast glamours using gear for the head, body, hands, legs, and feet, as well as the requisite number of glamour prisms. ※Please note that some glamours cannot be applied to certain characters due to incompatibility with race or gender. Glamour prisms may be obtained from the market board, Grand Company quartermasters, or crafted after obtaining the applicable master recipe.

■How to Reverse a Makeover Should you wish to revert a client's appearance, you will need a requisite number of glamour dispellers. These items may be obtained from the market board, Grand Company quartermasters, and other shops. For more information on glamours and how to dispel them, select the question mark icon on the Glamour Plate window.
Requirements and Rewards

Custom deliveries become available after completing their unlock quest. In order to deliver an item, you must be its corresponding class and a certain level or above. You may check whether or not you meet these requirements via the delivery list. Rewards will differ depending on your level at the time of delivery. Players who have not reached the level cap will be awarded experience points, and those who have will receive scrips. You may confirm what rewards you will receive given your current class by checking the bottom of the delivery list. ■Item Types Your clients deal only in collectables, which fall into three categories: crafted items, gathered items, and fish. Items can only be delivered when you are their corresponding class. The collectability of items will earn you proportional rewards. Furthermore, delivering items marked with BONUS will earn you particularly handsome rewards. Whenever they make an appearance, the effort to procure them will be worth your while. ■Delivery Allowances Each week, you can make up to six deliveries to any given client and up to twelve deliveries across all clients. Allowances will be reset every week on at 12 p.m.a.m. (Earth time).
Obtaining Items
Information on how to acquire individual items may be found via the relevant subcommand.

■Disciple of the Hand Items Choose the Search for Item by Crafting Method subcommand with the delivery list selected to open the crafting log and relevant recipes. Materials necessary to craft the collectables your client seeks may be purchased from a nearby NPC vendor. ■Miner and Botanist Items Choose the Search for Item by Gathering Method subcommand to open the gathering log and relevant maps. ■Fisher Items Choose the Display Location subcommand to open a map of the relevant fishing hole or teeming waters. Furthermore, you may discover that using a metal spinner as a lure will expedite your fishing endeavors.
Disciples of the Hand

The collectability of crafted items is directly related to their quality. Spare no effort in ensuring that the items you craft are of the highest possible quality, and you will be rewarded accordingly. The Inner Quiet status, granted each time you successfully increase quality, will serve you particularly well. Accumulate as many stacks of the status as you can, then put the final flourish on your masterpiece with Byregot's Blessing. There are a host of other actions that can serve to further enhance the quality of items you craft. Once you've mastered the fundamentals, you are encouraged to experiment with varied approaches until you find your preferred crafting method.
Miners and Botanists

Before gathering a collectable item, you must increase its collectability. One technique miners and botanists may employ to raise collectability is the use of Scrutiny followed by Scour. Try executing this combination a few times before gathering the item. Gatherers seeking to procure items with higher collectability must be certain to equip gear with higher gathering and perception ratings, as these attributes influence the effectiveness of actions that raise collectability. Of course, these actions cannot be used to their full potential without sufficient GP. A healthy balance of all three attributes is essential to make the most of your gathering. For more information, select the question mark icon on the window that opens upon choosing to gather a collectable item.
Fishers

The collectability value of fish follows a simple rule─the bigger, the better. Upon arriving at the fishing hole or teeming waters where your desired quarry resides, use the Collect action, then begin fishing or spearfishing.

When fishing, using Patience or Patience II followed by effective hooking actions will increase your chances of reeling in a big one. Should you still find yourself catching only small fry, try outfitting yourself with better equipment to raise your perception.
Phantom Blue Mage

The Phantom Blue Mage gains new actions not from increasing in level, but by learning from enemies. To acquire an ability, you must witness your foe perform that ability before defeating it. Only the player who strikes first, as well as their party members, may learn an action from the target enemy. In critical encounters, this applies to any player who is not incapacitated at the time of defeat. The actions you can learn are listed on the phantom job window under Phantom Traits.
Enemies
Elemental Weaknesses

The hostile creatures of the Occult Crescent have elemental weaknesses and take greater damage from attacks of that element. You can use the Phantom Red Mage's Occult Libra action to reveal these weaknesses and gain an advantage in battle.
The Forked Tower: Magic

The Forked Tower: Magic has two modes of difficulty, both of which require a knowledge level of 40 or greater. Entrance is granted by an aetherial node that only appears under certain conditions. A short time after the node appears, a maximum of 48 players standing upon it will be teleported inside. Should more than 48 players board the node, entrants will be randomly chosen. Those not selected will gain Forked Tower Priority for subsequent attempts, and players who have accumulated greater priority will then have a higher chance of being selected. Priority will reset upon successful entry to the Forked Tower: Magic at standard difficulty.
Furthermore, the Forked Tower: Magic (Extreme) requires a minimum of 12 entrants across three alliance parties. Speak with Jeffroy in the phantom village once you have assembled a suitable group.
North Horn
On the North Horn, there are two forms of currency: Enlightenment silver obols and Enlightenment gold obols.

■Enlightenment Silver Obols Primarily acquired from critical encounters and FATEs. ■Enlightenment Gold Obols Primarily acquired from defeating enemies in the wild. Both can be traded to the expedition antiquarian at the base camp for a variety of items.
Tool Mastery Missions
Tool Mastery Points

Tool mastery missions are only available to those who have completed a cosmic tool. Unlike normal stellar missions, the aim is to achieve the highest possible score within an allotted time. These missions include multiple intermediate objectives whose completion bonuses include extension of the time limit, additional use of duty actions, and increased evaluation scores. Tool mastery points are granted upon completion of a tool mastery mission, in accordance with the final score. Please refer to the Tool Mastery Points heading for more information. Bring to bear your experience and expertise as a Disciple of the Hand or Land, and reach for the stars! ■Accepting Missions Tool mastery missions can be accepted via the Tool Mastery Missions tab of the Stellar Missions window. This section will only be displayed on Auxesia.

Tool mastery points are gained in accordance with scores from tool mastery missions and accumulate for each individual class. Total points will be displayed for each class, demonstrating your mastery with each tool. Reaching certain milestones with a specific class will grant achievements and, in some cases, titles. Current points can be checked via the mission selection list, or via an overview found in the tool mastery point section of the Cosmic Class Tracker, accessed from your exotablet. Earn the achievements for all classes to obtain a special reward!
Keybound Brawler
Overview

Keybound Brawler is a dynamic typing challenge dreamed up by the Manderville Gold Saucer, designed for up to four players. ※This duty requires a keyboard. Please ensure that one is connected before registering for a game. Enemies will spawn in three major waves and march from the far edge of the battlefield towards your base. Each wave must be defeated before your base's barrier is broken. You may attack enemies by correctly inputting the words that display above them. The wave is cleared when all enemies are defeated. Your score will build as you input the correct terms and clear each wave. The higher your score, the higher your reward. Aim high and type swiftly to keep your barrier intact!
Participating

■Registration■ You may register for the duty by speaking with the Keybound registrar at Keybound Square. ■Registration Requirements■ All jobs and classes, including limited jobs, may participate in Keybound Brawler. ※If registering as a party, all party members must have unlocked Keybound Brawler to participate. ■Participants■ Players may register alone, or with a party of up to four players. Parties with less than four players will be matched with other participants via the Duty Finder. If four participants are not found within a set amount of time, players will enter the duty as an undersized party. ※Enemy HP will be adjusted based on the number of players participating.
Understanding the UI

This section explains the various elements of Keybound Brawler's unique UI.

1. Text Window
The text you type will be displayed here.

2. Words
Deal damage to approaching enemies by typing their words correctly into the text window. An enemy will only be defeated when its entire HP bar is depleted, with the number of successful word inputs required varying by enemy type and the number of players participating.

3. Wave Completion Requirements
The requirements for completing each wave will be displayed here.

4. Score and Bonus Gauge
Your score represents your typing skill.
Successfully entering words will earn you points, as well as increase the bonus gauge. The more your multiplier increases, the more bonus points you will earn towards your score with each successful attack.

5. HP Bar
The HP bar at the top of the screen represents the health of the player barrier. Enemy attacks will damage the barrier, and if your HP bar reaches zero...it's game over.
Controls

Only the keyboard is used to play Keybound Brawler. ■Controls■ To attack an enemy, type the word displayed above its head and press Enter. Your attack will fail if your word does not match any of the enemy words on screen. Text input will use your platform's standard input system, the same as that used for the chat function. Direct chat mode will be enabled while playing Keybound Brawler, regardless of your current Character Configuration settings. You can also press the up arrow key while in the text window to bring up your typing history.
Input Rules

■Capitalization■ Words and phrases can be entered entirely in uppercase or lowercase letters, or any combination thereof. Only the spelling will determine a successful attack. ■Punctuation Marks■ When typing words and phrases with punctuation marks, the following symbols must be included for the attack to be successful: Periods (.) Commas (,) Spaces ( ) Question marks (?), exclamation marks (!), hyphens (-), and apostrophes (') are optional. For example, the following inputs for “Hi-potion” would be accepted: “hi-potion” “Hipotion” But the following would not: “hi potion”
Tips for Improving Your Score

Successfully entering a word increases your bonus multiplier, which is then applied to the points you earn. The bonus gauge will slowly decrease if you fail to earn points, so a consistent stream of accurate typing is crucial to maintaining a large multiplier and building that high score. It is also important to minimize enemy damage to your barrier, as the points awarded upon completing a wave will change based on the barrier's remaining HP. Lastly, keep an eye out for the appearance of magic pots! Should you manage to defeat a magic pot before it flees, you will be overcome with typing fever and granted the Impassioned Inputs status, massively boosting your potential to earn bonus points!
Enemy Special Attacks
■Spells Susceptible to Interruption■ Certain spells can be interrupted by landing a specific number of attacks. This number is displayed under the progress bar.

■Letterlock■ When enemies are casting, take note of special icons like the one below. Once the progress bar fills completely, you must refrain from pressing any keys for a period of time until the enemy attack glows brightly. Fail to do so and you will be rendered immobile even longer as penalty.

■Cryptic Communications■ Under this status affliction, words are largely concealed from view, save for brief glimpses. These hidden words can still be entered, so watch closely and memorize them while you can!

■Barrier Busters■ Some attacks must be blocked by the base barrier. When the enemy's progress bar appears, enter the words displayed over the barrier to power it up. Once the gauge is filled, the fully charged barrier will nullify all attacks for a short time.
Rewards

■Manderville Gold Saucer Credits (MGC)■ These credits are awarded for every game of Keybound Brawler. The higher your score, the more MGC you'll earn! You can view the number of credits in your possession by speaking with the MGC trader or registrar at Keybound Square. Please note that you can carry up to 10,000 credits at one time. ■Spending Your MGC■ Speak with the MGC trader at Keybound Square to exchange your MGC for a variety of prizes.

Crucible Effect

The Crucible of the Unbroken is a magicked tool originally designed to train beastmasters. The challenger is transported to a board across which they must traverse, defeating the shades of dangerous beasts along the way.

You may challenge the Crucible of the Unbroken at any time by speaking with Lauda in Bentbranch Meadows.

Boards are comprised of seven types of spaces, each represented by a different icon: enemy, elite enemy, boss, campsite, shop, treasure, and random.

Beastmasters must clear a path forward and ultimately defeat the boss on the innermost space.
Boards have different rules regarding team size, the highest allowance set at fifteen familiars. Study the weaknesses of opponents on any given board to strategically build your team.

Within the Crucible, familiars have individual HP and can draw enmity. Once a familiar's HP reaches zero, they will become incapacitated and therefore unable to be summoned during combat. Neither players nor familiars naturally regenerate HP, so items and spaces must be used wisely to facilitate recovery.

Two duty actions are available within the Crucible: Snarl and Challenge. Snarl orders your familiar to draw enmity and take damage on your behalf via the effects of Cover. Challenge draws enmity to yourself and removes Cover from your familiar. Use these duty actions to distribute damage taken and manage HP accordingly.

Spaces marked with enemy, elite enemy, or boss icons host battles against the shades of beasts. After assigning familiars to your battlehorns via the team composition list, select “Commence Battle” to access Crucible battlegrounds. Defeat opponents to clear the space.

Note that while victory will earn you spoils such as ephemeral items and territory tokens, defeat will expel you from the Crucible of the Unbroken.

Players and familiars may rest on spaces marked with a campsite icon, thereby recovering HP. While the tent will always house a beastmaster, campsites differ regarding the number of familiars they can accommodate. Resting fewer familiars than the maximum allowance will restore more HP to those who do rest. Furthermore, familiars will lose all effects of feed upon resting.
Players may trade territory tokens for a variety of items on spaces marked with a shop icon. Occasionally, items will be discounted, so be sure to carefully examine the wares on offer.

Coffers rich with spoils are marked with a treasure icon. Players may select one ephemeral item from any given coffer, and two when in possession of a thief's knife. Please note that ephemeral items can only be used within the Crucible of the Unbroken.
A random icon indicates that the space blindly hosts an enemy, elite enemy, campsite, shop, or treasure coffer.

There are three types of ephemeral items: beast gear, crucible items, and feed. These duty-specific items will help you successfully clear the Crucible of the Unbroken.

You will be granted one piece of beast gear and one crucible item upon entering the Crucible. Inventories cannot be transferred between boards. Furthermore, as ephemeral items are temporary in nature, they will be lost upon clearing the board or defeat.

Players need only acquire beast gear to benefit from their effects. Players may carry up to ten pieces, but cannot possess duplicates. Beast gear may be won by defeating enemies, purchased on shop spaces, or obtained from treasure spaces.

Crucible items must be expended to benefit from their effects. Players may carry up to ten, stored in slots, and duplicates are permitted. These items can be added to the hotbar by dragging and dropping or via the subcommand.

Crucible items may be won by defeating enemies, purchased on shop spaces, or obtained from treasure spaces.

Feeding your familiars will grant them beneficial effects. Satiety determines how much feed a familiar can consume, and familiars will not eat more than one of any given type of feed. Effects of feed will be lost upon resting at a campsite or incapacitation.

A score will be calculated for performance within the Crucible of the Unbroken, regardless of success or failure. The number and type of enemies defeated, a player's remaining HP, and numerous other factors contribute to this aggregate score.

Players seeking the highest score possible should pay special attention to the Crucible's bonuses, which may be viewed when challenging any given board. Playing with certain strategies in mind will fulfill bonus requirements and boost your score accordingly. Note that different boards may offer different bonuses.

Players may participate in rankings by checking the appropriate box when entering the Crucible. Please note that scores will not be applicable to rankings unless this box is checked. Rankings are aggregated from the three latest attempts on each board. In other words, you must challenge all five boards at least three times each to record fifteen separate scores, the total of which will be reflected upon your ranking. Should any board already have three recorded scores, the oldest score will be replaced by the latest one. The highest ranked players will be featured on the Lodestone's Standings page and will receive special rewards for maintaining their ranking after a certain period has passed.

Upon achieving a certain score or higher, players may earn rewards. Higher scores result in greater returns, both in experience points and items. Particularly high scores will increase the rate of rare item drops.

In the course of combating the Crucible's denizens, you may discover remnants of their resilience. These curious objects can be traded for Kornago gourds, which forge pacts with new familiars, or used to augment artifact armor, obtained at level 50.
You may leave the Crucible of the Unbroken by selecting “Forfeit” via the duty-specific window, or “Leave” via the Duty Menu. Forfeiting will be treated as a failed attempt.

Select “Suspend Progress” from the duty-specific window to save your data and temporarily withdraw from the Crucible of the Unbroken. You cannot suspend progress on a space that has yet to be cleared.

Speak with Lauda and select “Resume progress” to pick up where you left off. Should you select “Challenge the Crucible of the Unbroken” with suspended data on file, the suspended data will be erased upon entering the Crucible anew.

Familiars in your team will gain experience points proportionate to your earned score. Beast rank increases for every 100 EXP, and once familiars reach beast rank 25, they may be glamoured via the Master's Bestiary.

Familiar attributes are enhanced as beast rank increases. These parameters are only active while challenging the Crucible of the Unbroken: Strength: Affects physical damage dealt. Intelligence: Affects magic damage dealt. Physical Resistance: Affects physical vulnerability. Magic Resistance: Affects magic vulnerability. Constitution: Affects maximum HP.
Degrees are difficulty levels designed strictly as a challenge for players. Upon entry, players may choose to challenge the Crucible under the first, second, or third degree.

The higher the degree, the harder the challenge. The strength and maximum HP of opponents on enemy spaces will be enhanced accordingly. Only beastmasters with a discerning eye for ephemeral items and unparalleled knowledge of their familiars will be able to overcome the Crucible at its hottest.

Clearing boards under degrees satisfies a corresponding bonus requirement, thus boosting a player's final score and subsequent rewards. Furthermore, some achievements may only be obtained by clearing boards under a certain degree.

Artifact armor obtained at level 50 will benefit from enhancements within the Crucible of the Unbroken. This Crucible effect will remain active regardless of level syncs or item level syncs, so it is recommended that players augment artifact armor before challenging increasingly difficult boards.

Reaching an objective will result in the following kinds of changes: ・Time limit: 2:00 → 3:20 ・GP: 350/900 → 850/900 ※GP will not be restored beyond maximum. ・Duty action: 2/2 → 3/3 ・Score multiplier: 100% → 150% ■Tips The key to success is to use duty actions to reach objectives and achieve a higher score. When an objective is met, the score multiplier will increase, and each subsequent point will contribute more to the overall score. Once you can comfortably complete certain missions with a limited number of duty actions, it may be wise to save those actions to use once your score multiplier has increased. This will allow you to increase your score more effectively. However, should you focus too much on keeping duty actions in reserve, you may fail to meet the objectives within the time limit. Striking the appropriate balance is essential! For Disciples of the Land, making effective use of your GP before reaching an objective will allow for more GP to be recovered, giving you more opportunity to achieve a higher score. If you are struggling to complete tool mastery missions or boost your score, try using medicines and meals for Disciples of the Hand and Land or reviewing your gear and materia. It is also important to consider the actions you use and the order in which you use them. ■Rewards Upon completion of a mission, you will receive tool mastery points in accordance with your score. Cosmic class score and contribution to the Starward Standings will also increase accordingly, up to a maximum amount granted per mission. Credits and exploration tokens are not impacted by score. ■Mission High Score A high score will be recorded for each tool mastery mission completed. High scores can be viewed on the mission selection screen. Retry missions and find ways to achieve a new high score on your path to earning the related achievements and titles! ■Bonuses Tool mastery missions marked with a symbol on the mission select screen will bestow a bonus, granting 1.2 times the standard amount of tool mastery points.

■Gold Count
Completing or abandoning tool mastery missions will not affect your gold count.
Arcane Amulets
Arcane amulets can be obtained from coffers in the Forked Tower: Magic. They can be traded to the expedition antiquarian at the base camp for a variety of items.

■Requirements Tool mastery missions are only available on Auxesia when the cosmic tool of the corresponding class has been completed. ■Mission Progression There are two different score objectives in tool mastery missions. You may choose to complete the mission at any point after reaching the first objective. If, however, you wish to aim for a higher score, you can continue working towards the second. After reaching both the first and second objective, the mission will continue until the time runs out. During this remaining time, you can further increase your score. ■Completion Bonuses A bonus will be granted upon reaching the first and second objectives, with the following effects: ・Increased time limit ・Additional uses of the mission duty action ・GP recovery An extra 50% or 100% boost will also be added to the score multiplier, making it easier to achieve an even higher score. See below for an example completion bonus.

■Restrictions■ While playing, you will be unable to use the following: ・Chat ・Auto-translate ・Keyboard shortcuts ■Abandoning the Game■ You may exit Keybound Brawler at any time by pressing the escEsc key. Be warned that you will not receive any rewards and may incur a Duty Finder penalty. Furthermore, you will be removed from the duty and subject to a Duty Finder penalty if no inputs are detected for a prolonged period of time.
Crucible Rankings
How to Participate
Crucible Ranking Score
Players must set the Crucible Mode to “Third Degree” and check the box next to “Participate in rankings.” Scores will not be applied to rankings unless these conditions are met.

Your Crucible Ranking Score is aggregated from the last three attempts of each board. In other words, by challenging all five boards at least three times, you will record fifteen separate scores that are totaled to determine your Crucible Ranking Score. Once three scores are recorded for a board, the oldest score will be erased upon recording a new one. Scores will not be recorded if the box next to “Participate in rankings” remains unchecked. Players with the highest scores will be featured on the Lodestone's Crucible Rankings page and will receive special rewards for maintaining their place after a certain period has passed.
Elite enemies are stronger than their normal counterparts, but defeating them may yield greater and rarer rewards.
Bosses reside upon the innermost space and are the ultimate challenge of any given board. Triumph over these enemies to successfully clear the duty.
